results.evidence: check_records calls import_records(..., dry_run=True). That function opens BEGIN, and at the end calls conn.rollback() when dry_run, otherwise commit. Any exception goes to `except BaseException: conn.rollback(); raise`. The savepoint failure path rolls back to the savepoint and re-raises into the same outer rollback. So both the normal exit and the exception exit discard the writes. The CLI connection comes from db.connect (db.py:66), which is a plain sqlite3.connect in legacy isolation mode, not autocommit=True. rollback() therefore takes effect. The CLI also closes the connection in a finally block (cli.py:~811), which would discard anything uncommitted. The new tests' _check_and_import helper counts organizations, contacts, leads, evidence and activities (TABLES) through a separate connection before and after --check, and asserts they are equal. I ran `uv run --offline pytest -q tests/test_prospects_check_same_file.py tests/test_prospects_check.py`: 9 passed.
